events.summary: Fixed tool-event call signature and replaced dead TTS outbox path with direct Piper synthesis/resample/playback.
Added lazy Kokoro English TTS, Piper German path, language detection and fallback behavior.
PTT routed through real response+TTS path, audio sink selection and Whisper artifact filtering; cancel control surfaced but causal suppression was completed next commit.
Restart stale voice events skipped; cancel flag suppresses completed chat/voice results; screenshot triggers tightened against false positives.
IP location fallback chain expanded after rate-limit/DNS failures caused false timezone fallback.
Long Kokoro text chunking avoids index overflow; invalid cross-language Piper fallback removed instead of degrading silently.
Tracks current audio playback process and terminates prior playback to prevent concurrent duplicate TTS effects.
Mic/audio selection delegated to system default rather than brittle hardware-name heuristics.
Whisper medium/auto-language and audio preprocessing improved recognition; resource/thread cost increased.
Chat-mode self-analysis fabricated a nonexistent Titan timestamp bug. Fix routes code inspection to real agentic tools and adds explicit action-honesty rules.
Voice had a separate path bypassing agentic detection; added equivalent agentic routing and missing English self-analysis triggers.
Agentic self-analysis wasted 20 iterations on generic host checks because code location was unknown; injects actual source/DB paths and preferred read tools.
Global fs_write-before-final rule made read-only analysis impossible; separated analysis completion from creation completion semantics.
Brittle self-analysis substring list replaced by flexible action/system/bug regex families spanning subsystem names and word orders.
Blocks parallel chat during agentic mode, detects duplicate tool calls, injects JSON repair hints, distinguishes files/DBs, and forces evidence-based finalization after successful reads.
ASRS counted errors generated by its own restart/revalidation actions, creating restart->error->recovery cascade; lifecycle messages were excluded from application error signal.

cross_branch_findings: No claimed perception, self-analysis or action is valid without a corresponding tool/effect receipt; k487 is a concrete fabricated-action failure oracle.
Routing/authority semantics must be modality-invariant: typed and voice paths must reach the same Needle/agentic gate; k486 proves a split-path bypass.
Task effect contracts must distinguish READ/ANALYZE from WRITE/CREATE; a universal write-success completion condition can deadlock legitimate analysis.
Agent tool loops need resource identity and duplicate-call suppression plus parser-repair limits; otherwise small-model JSON failure creates unbounded repeated effects.
Recovery telemetry must exclude or causally tag recovery's own interventions; k481 is a direct self-exciting controller failure.
Cancellation is only real if downstream results/effects are causally suppressed, not merely if UI state changes.
External sensor/provider fallback must preserve provenance and uncertainty; silent timezone fallback is not equivalent to observed location.

credit.reason: Sub-denominator semantic closure only; historical mechanism value overlaps current Harness/Needle/safety mappings and needs final row-level dedup.
